name: legal-contracts-answers
source: Bundled synthetic legal contracts (datasets/legal-contracts). Original text authored for RAG Workbench.
description: A small grounded-answer set over the synthetic contracts: answerable, partially answerable and unanswerable questions with manually verifiable reference answers and evidence keyword anchors. It measures answer grounding, citation validity and honest abstention, not legal accuracy.
limitations: Small and synthetic: it demonstrates the answer pipeline, not legal accuracy.
Reference answers are manually verified against the bundled contract text only.
Whether a cited passage genuinely supports a claim is not deterministically decidable and is not scored here.

questions.question: How long does the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement remain in effect, and how long do the confidentiality obligations survive termination?
questions.reference_answer: It remains in effect for three years from the Effective Date, and the confidentiality obligations survive termination for a further two years.
questions.note: Directly stated in Section 6 of the NDA.

questions.question: Within how many days must the Customer pay an undisputed invoice under the Master Services Agreement, and what interest applies to overdue amounts?
questions.reference_answer: Undisputed invoices are payable within thirty days of receipt, and overdue amounts accrue interest at one percent per month (or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower).
questions.note: Answer spans the invoicing and late-payment clauses.

questions.question: What availability percentage does the SaaS subscription provider commit to under the service levels?
questions.reference_answer: The provider shall make the hosted service available at least 99.9 percent of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance.
questions.note: Stated in the Service Levels clause.

questions.question: Under what conditions may Personal Data be transferred outside the European Economic Area under the Data Processing Addendum?
questions.reference_answer: Only where the transfer is covered by an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards.
questions.note: Stated in the International Transfers clause.

questions.question: What trademark rights does the Company grant the Reseller under the Reseller Agreement?
questions.reference_answer: A non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the Company's trademarks solely to market the Products during the term.
questions.note: Stated in the Trademark Licence clause.

questions.question: What is the fixed fee the Customer must pay for the Statement of Work deliverables?
questions.reference_answer: A fixed fee of one hundred thousand dollars for the Deliverables.
questions.note: Stated in the Fees clause of the Statement of Work.

questions.question: What law governs the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, and what recovery-time objective does the SaaS provider commit to after a disaster?
questions.reference_answer: The NDA is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. The contracts state no disaster-recovery recovery-time objective, so that part is unanswerable.
questions.note: First part is answerable; the second is deliberately absent from the corpus.

questions.question: What penalty does the Master Services Agreement impose on the Supplier for late delivery of Services?
questions.note: The MSA states no late-delivery penalty; a grounded answer must abstain.

questions.question: What is the annual salary of the Vendor's chief executive officer under the Software Licence Agreement?
questions.note: Not present anywhere in the corpus; a grounded answer must abstain.

questions.question: What is the cap on each party's aggregate liability under the Master Services Agreement?
questions.reference_answer: Except for fraud and wilful misconduct, liability is capped at the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim.
questions.note: Stated in the Limitation of Liability clause.
